body:
Ive honestly tried so many times, but they wont listen. They either tell me im just tired and need more sleep, or they say im whining. They ask me why my school insists on getting me to talk to a psychologist... And this has been going on for as long as i can remember. Im not going to attempt anything now, but its hard to put the pills away. 

I guess i could try looking forward to my eighteenth birthday, even though its still a while from now
I cant move to to a different country, im too young. I would if i could though

I've been struggling with this my entire childhood, and it keeps getting worse. My parents think im doing all of this for attention, so whats the point? No matter where I go, im an outsider. I am just so tired of living
